## Last-checked: 2026-08-20

# bundles

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bundles

## Status

**Public repository.** Waves 1 and 2, containing the thirteen bundles in this
projection, were released on 2026-08-08 after their publication check and an
explicit owner decision. Future waves remain independently gated: a recipe is
added only after its wave's branding, publication check and explicit owner
decision meet the three release conditions in `README.md`.

## Summary

`bundles` is the recipe layer of the ellmos ecosystem: bundle manifests, a
catalogue excerpt, and the export tool that projects them out of a private
composition repository. A bundle manifest is a recipe — the ingredient list
(components, all public on their own) plus the seed (which parts belong
together, which role each fills, which alternative was chosen and why). The
manifests are not maintained here; they are reproducibly projected from the
private source, and every file carries a `content_hash` that makes the
projection verifiable rather than merely asserted.

## Audience

- Readers of the ellmos ecosystem who want to see how its components compose
  into working units, not just that the components exist.
- Anyone deciding whether a given set of skills, agent roles and access
  surfaces adds up to something coherent before deploying it.
- Maintainers of the sibling repository `open-ocean` (the runtime that will
  eventually consume these recipes) and of the source composition repository.

## Important Files

- `README.md` — English overview: what a bundle is, the two rings, the
  release conditions, how the projection works.
- `README_de.md` — German counterpart, kept in 1:1 parity.
- `README.md` — the release conditions, including the independently checkable
  gate for each future wave.
- `manifests/bundles.catalog.v1.json` — the machine-readable index of all
  exported bundles.
- `manifests/bundles/<bundle-id>/bundle.v1.json` — one manifest per bundle.
- `contracts/` — the two contracts every bundle manifest is checked against.
- `docs/bundles/README.md` — the human-readable index, grouped by pillar,
  with every banner.
- `docs/bundles/<bundle-id>.md` — one page per bundle, in German.
- `tools/export_from_source.py` — the reproducible projection tool.
- `tools/generate_banner.py` — the banner generator (frozen design system).

## Search Phrases

```text
ellmos bundle manifest recipe seed ingredient list
bundle catalogue composition knowledge choice groups
ellmos-ai bundles recipe layer open-ocean
reproducible export projection content_hash verification
which components form a working ellmos deployment
```

## Boundaries

`bundles` is not a runtime and starts nothing on its own — a recipe is
executed by an agent CLI the reader already runs, not by this repository.
The full consuming system is `open-ocean`, a separate repository, kept apart
so that a recipe available today never implies a system that is not built
yet. Bundles whose components are not all public are deliberately absent
rather than shipped with their alternatives trimmed away. This index
describes the 13 bundles currently in the projection; it is not the full
catalogue the private source repository holds.
